subject.title: fix: models status auth, browser local-file nav, codex workspace app-server, tui empty sessions

question: Should Codex app-server workspace-write turns gain network egress by default for existing users, or should network remain default-denied with an explicit opt-in or separate design?
rationale: This PR changes a sandbox boundary and upgrade behavior that code review cannot safely approve without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Keep default denied
options.body: Restore networkAccess: false for workspace-write and pursue any network-enabled app-server behavior as an explicit opt-in with docs and proof.

options.title: Accept default egress
options.body: Approve network-enabled workspace-write as the new default and require matching security documentation, upgrade notes, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Split the PR
options.body: Move the TUI, browser, and models-status fixes separately while the sandbox direction is decided.

recommendation.title: Keep default denied
recommendation.body: Restore networkAccess: false for workspace-write and pursue any network-enabled app-server behavior as an explicit opt-in with docs and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The history pass shows recent work across Codex app-server, browser security, and auth-provider scope surfaces affected by this decision.
